I fixed the typo: `recipent` is now `recipient` in `services/notifier/migrations/202609011200_create_outbox.sql:4`. Nothing else in the repo used the misspelled name, and the notifier's tests pass (1 test).

The project notes say the notifier hasn't launched yet (launch is planned for 2026-11), so none of its migrations have been applied to a shared database. Until launch, editing them directly is the expected way to fix mistakes.
